nodes.label: Same-Origin Account Security
nodes.rationale: Frontend and backend must share an origin when accounts or state-changing actions are enabled so session and CSRF cookies remain first-party.

nodes.label: Conservative Riot Refresh Limits
nodes.rationale: Local refresh ceilings and retry settings stay below the deployed Riot key limits, while failed refreshes preserve the last successful dashboard data.

nodes.label: Atomic Snapshot Publication Invariants
nodes.rationale: Immutable side-by-side aggregation versions and transactional publication ensure a failed run cannot replace the last published snapshot.

nodes.label: Browser Rendering Boundary
nodes.rationale: The browser owns filters, rendering, accessibility, URL synchronization, and exact-key caching, while ranking, weighting, confidence, and fallback decisions remain on the backend.
